citation: Sanchez-Aguadero N, Patino-Alonso MC, Mora-Simon S, et al. Postprandial Effects of Breakfast Glycemic Index on Vascular Function among Young Healthy Adults: A Crossover Clinical Trial. Nutrients. 2017;9(7):712.
protocol: Three conditions, crossover: water; high-GI breakfast (200 mL grape juice, 40 g white bread, 29 g jam, with 350 mL water); low-GI breakfast (composition in methods). Blood at 0, 60, 120 min.
population: 40 young healthy adults, 50% women, aged 20-40; Spain (Salamanca).

reports.where: Table 3: 0, 60, 120 min mean and SD per breakfast

note: A small carbohydrate breakfast in a larger mixed-sex group, with SD at each time. The insulin row is labelled 'mg/dL', which must be a typo for µU/mL. The low-GI breakfast's grams need to be read from the methods. Meal kinds: mixed meal.
